solutions.latex:
Let $\theta$ be the angle at Trinityton between the west direction and the line to $K$. In the right-angled triangle, $\tan\theta = \dfrac{230}{320}$.
$$\theta = 36^\circ$$
The bearing of $K$ from Trinityton is measured from north, and west is $270^\circ$.
$$\begin{aligned} \text{Bearing} &= 270 - 36 \\ &= 234^\circ \end{aligned}$$
Hence the answer is option C.

solutions.latex:
Scuttle flies south $1050$ km from the buoy, then west $475$ km. The angle $\theta$ at the buoy is between the south line and the line to Scuttle's final position.

\exfigure{3296_q6c_s1}

meta.format_note: Kept the \exfigure from source; it should be labelled $1050$, $475$, $\theta$ and the bearing angle.

solutions.latex:
In the right-angled triangle, $\theta$ is at the buoy, with opposite side $475$ and adjacent side $1050$.
$$\tan\theta = \dfrac{475}{1050}$$
$$\theta = 24^\circ \text{ (nearest degree)}$$
The bearing is measured clockwise from north, and the flight is south-west of the buoy.
$$\begin{aligned} \text{Bearing} &= 180^\circ+24^\circ \\ &= 204^\circ \end{aligned}$$

The buoy is north-east of Scuttle, at the angle $24^\circ$ from north, from part (b).
$$\text{N}24^\circ\text{E}$$

7727.stem:
A yacht, $A$, is 7 km from a lighthouse, $O$, on a bearing of $210^\circ$ as shown below.

\exfigure{3297_q21_1}

figures.cap: lighthouse O with north arrow and yacht A at 7 km on bearing 210 degrees
solution sketch: ferry B at 3 km on bearing 135 degrees
solution sketch: angle AOB of 75 degrees marked

parts.latex: A ferry can also be seen from the lighthouse. The ferry is 3 km from $O$ on a bearing of $135^\circ$. On the diagram above, label the position of the ferry, $B$, and show an angle to indicate its bearing.
Calculate the distance, in km, between the ferry and the yacht correct to one decimal place.

solutions.latex:
In triangle $OAB$, $OA = 7$, $OB = 3$ and $\angle AOB = 75^\circ$. Using the cosine rule:
$$\begin{aligned} AB^2 &= 7^2 + 3^2 - 2 \times 7 \times 3 \times \cos 75^\circ \\ AB &= 6.8651\ldots \\ &\approx 6.9 \text{ km} \end{aligned}$$
$$\therefore\ \text{the distance between the ferry and the yacht is } 6.9 \text{ km}$$
criteria: Uses the cosine rule with one correct value, or equivalent merit
